mechanisms.behavior: START causes trough-eject output 4 in exact runtime. Loader initializes numbered TROUGH 1-3 routes, then the probe explicitly transfers one synthetic occupancy to shooter 11 and exit 12. Physical trough topology, ball count, sensors, jam response, travel and launcher construction are unresolved.
mechanisms.label: Firmware-named trough and shooter routing

mechanisms.behavior: Names suggest a reset bank only. Earlier exploratory simultaneous target assertions did not satisfy an output-8 checkpoint; no successful reset, physical linkage, target part, travel or reset policy is established.
mechanisms.label: Firmware-named three-drop reset candidate

mechanisms.behavior: Exact labels identify a right-ramp lock output and candidate lockup sensors. Their association and physical topology are unproven; no lock actuation or release sequence was tested.
mechanisms.label: Firmware-named right ramp lock candidate
